newsitem.title: USA: Cali Realty retires $64.5 mln of financing.
newsitem.headline: Cali Realty retires $64.5 mln of financing.

text.p: Cali Realty Corp said on Wednesday that it has retired the company's $64.5 million real estate mortgage investment conduit (REMIC) secured financing.
The prepaid balance was made available primarily from funds drawn on the company's new $400 million unsecured credit facility, it said in a statement.
Also, Cali said that Prudential Realty Funding Corp has increased the company's existing revolving credit facility to $100 million from $80 million and extended the maturity date to August 31, 1998.
The interest rate on the facility remains unchanged at LIBOR plus 125 basis points, Cali said.
Cali's total borrowing capacity under its revolving credit lines currently aggregates $500 million, of which the company has $230 million in borrowings outstanding, it said.

With the retirement of the secured REMIC financing, Cali now has 83 unencumbered properties totaling seven million square feet, representing approximately 58 percent of the Company's portfolio, it said.
